_sources: Builds, driver floors and compute capabilities: as runtimes/torch's, whose torch (2.14.0) this runtime pins; see its _sources.
Wheels: every package in uv.lock has a cp314 or pure-Python wheel for win_amd64 and manylinux x86_64, so an install compiles nothing (checked 2026-11-05).
disk_mb is left out until spec 005's bench:runtime report measures a real install.
The upstreams: microsoft/MoGe at 74fbce0, the commit spec 005's spike ran, and EasternJournalist/utils3d-moge at 62f09d5, the commit MoGe's own package names.
FlexGEMM: MoGe-3's code imports it at the top and runs it only in its refinement; its kernels need Triton on a card of compute 8.0 or newer. A stand-in here, until such a card reports (spec 005).
Each source's sha256 is of GitHub's archive as downloaded on the owner's PC (2026-11-05); `git archive --format=tar --prefix=<repo>-<commit>/ <commit> | gzip -n` on a clone gives the same bytes.
title: MoGe
summary: Microsoft's MoGe-2 and MoGe-3, from their GitHub code: a metric point map, depth, normals and the camera from one photo.
